description: This source file defines the DebugActions enum containing various static methods for debugging and operational actions within the OpenClaw macOS application. It includes functions for opening windows, logs, config folders, restarting gateways, resetting tunnels, and other utilities related to debugging and app control.

classes.name: DebugActionError
classes.description: An enum representing errors related to debug actions, specifically for message-based errors.

methods.name: openAgentEventsWindow
methods.description: Opens a window displaying agent events, setting up an NSWindow with a SwiftUI view.

methods.name: openLog
methods.description: Opens the log file in the system's file viewer, alerting if the log file doesn't exist.

methods.name: openConfigFolder
methods.description: Opens the application's configuration folder in the system's file viewer.

methods.name: openSessionStore
methods.description: Opens the session store location, either in a viewer or explorer, based on file existence.

methods.name: sendTestNotification
methods.description: Sends a test notification asynchronously via NotificationManager.

methods.name: sendDebugVoice
methods.description: Sends a debug voice command asynchronously and returns success or failure.

methods.name: restartGateway
methods.description: Restarts the app's gateway depending on the connection mode, managing various internal processes.

methods.name: resetGatewayTunnel
methods.description: Resets the SSH tunnel if in remote mode, re-establishing the control tunnel.

methods.name: pinoLogPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the log file.

methods.name: runHealthCheckNow
methods.description: Triggers an immediate health check refresh.

methods.name: sendTestHeartbeat
methods.description: Sends a test heartbeat request and returns the response or error.

methods.name: verboseLoggingEnabledMain
methods.description: Accessor for the verbose logging setting from user defaults.

methods.name: toggleVerboseLoggingMain
methods.description: Toggles verbose logging setting and updates the server.

methods.name: restartApp
methods.description: Restarts the application by relaunching the process.

methods.name: restartOnboarding
methods.description: Resets onboarding state and restarts onboarding process.

methods.name: resolveSessionStorePath
methods.description: Resolves the session store path from configuration or defaults.

methods.name: recentSessions
methods.description: Fetches recent session entries with a limit.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates session information with specified keys and levels.

methods.name: checkGatewayPorts
methods.description: Diagnoses gateway ports status.

methods.name: killProcess
methods.description: Attempts to terminate a process by PID, with force kill if needed.

methods.name: openSessionStoreInCode
methods.description: Opens the session store in Visual Studio Code.
